errors.text_span: Der Balken für „Plattformdienste“ im „Produzierendes Gewerbe inklusive Bau“ ist der längste
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. The longest bar in the chart represents 'Dienstleistungen ohne öffentlichen Dienst' (light blue) for the 'Plattformdienste' category, with a value of approximately 67%. The bar for 'Produzierendes Gewerbe inklusive Bau' (dark blue) in the same category is visibly shorter (approx. 63%).

The bar for 'Plattformdienste' in 'Produzierendes Gewerbe inklusive Bau' (dark blue) reaches approximately 63%, not 65%. The value of 65% more closely corresponds to the bar for 'Öffentlicher Dienst' (grey) in the same technology category.

errors.text_span: Bei allen Technologiekategorien ist der dunkelblaue Balken (Produzierendes Gewerbe inklusive Bau) in der Regel länger als der hellblaue (Dienstleistungen ohne öffentlichen Dienst) und der graue (Öffentlicher Dienst).
errors.evidence: This sentence makes a comparative generalization ('in der Regel länger' - usually longer) which is a form of interpretation forbidden by the prompt. Furthermore, the generalization is factually incorrect; the dark blue bar is shorter than the other bars in several instances (e.g., for 'Plattformdienste' it is shorter than both other bars).

The description does not mention that the technology categories on the vertical axis are sorted in descending order based on their overall share percentages, which is a clear organizational feature of the chart.
